thread:
ira: Heads up — partner SFTP drop (sftp://partner-z/drops/2026-05-02.tar.gz) contains credentials.enc. Header indicates vault-transit:v1 and wrap key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/wrap-ingest-01. Treat as potential exposure and quarantine.
jen: Copy. Can you post sha256 and object path and set quarantine ACLs?
ira: sha256=8f2c...a7e; quarantined to gs://redwood-quarantine/partner-z/2026-05-02.tar.gz (object locked, readonly). Notifying partner-success and legal.
mike: audit-bot shows a burst of KMS decrypt attempts against wrap-ingest-01 from partner-sa@partner-z in last 15m — 9 attempts. Possible misconfigured client or replay.
audit-bot: Alert: KMS.decrypt anomaly for wrap-ingest-01 — 9 events from partner-sa@partner-z, 1 event from unknown IP. Created case SEC-2026-112. Extended vault & cloudkms logs to 180 days.
jen: Immediate actions: 1) snapshot and quarantine (done) 2) do non-destructive scan for high-entropy tokens and known token formats 3) run vault transit audit for unwraps 4) draft RBAC change to narrow partner SA permissions 5) prepare rewrap runbook but do not execute until legal/partner signoff.
ira: running safe scan (streamed, no plaintext dump): rg -ai "(api_key|token|secret|password|private_key)" --hidden --no-ignore -z <(zcat 2026-05-02.tar.gz) || true. Found 1 high-entropy candidate labeled "candidate-token-01" and redacted sample uploaded to SEC-2026-112.
mike: checking vault logs: no successful transit/unwrap entries for wrap-ingest-01 by our services. Looks like partner wrapped but never requested unwrap here.
legal-liaison: Legal: please do not alter original object beyond readonly quarantine. Package redacted samples and metadata for partner intake. We need chain-of-custody.
infra-oncall: I'll prepare a rotation plan that avoids service downtime: create new wrap key (wrap-ingest-01-rot), add as primary for new uploads, add v1 as fallback for grace period, update ingesters to prefer new key. Streaming rewrap into quarantine bucket can be done after partner okays.
jen: RBAC draft: remove broad project-level roles from partner SA on cryptoKeys; grant only kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToEncrypt for upload principal and restrict decrypt to our vault service account. Add condition limiting calls to requests originating from partner SFTP IP ranges.
audit-bot: Reminder: attach audit exports to SEC-2026-112 and alert SOC if any external access to quarantine object occurs.
ira: timeline: quarantine done. Next: jen to open infra PR for RBAC tighten (ETA 2h), mike to produce vault/kms unwrap timeline (ETA 1h), infra-oncall to draft runbook & streaming rewrap script (ETA 3h), legal to confirm partner intake flow (ETA 1h). Keep updates short here. :lock:
